name: dfd-wcag-ada-audit-framework
description: A framework for auditing web content for WCAG and ADA compliance
author: Dean Forant

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.audit: node -e "import('./scanner.js').then(async s => { const n = await import('./normalizer.js'); const r = await import('./reporter.js'); const raw = await s.runScan(); const norm = n.normalizeAxeResults(raw); r.writeReportToFile(norm); });"
